text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Adhesive bandages, gauze... Hmm, for 
medicine, just disinfectant should be 
enough, right?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Oh, Trainer-san.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, that's not it~. I was just looking 
for something to put in my bag.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
You see, my Racewear... comes with a cute 
bag as a set.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to pack useful things in case 
someone gets hurt...
choice_data_list: You're such a kind person, huh.
You're such a kind person, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: No, it's nothing like that.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Ah... if it's alright with you, Trainer, 
would you like to help me pick what goes 
in my bag~?

At Super Creek's request, I looked for 
something portable and useful.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much, Trainer. Look, it 
fits perfectly~.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Even if someone gets hurt, I should at 
least be able to give them first aid~.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, please tell me right away if you 
ever get hurt, okay?♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Even during a race, of course.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, when that happens, I'll cross the 
finish line faster than ever, so don't 
worry—

text_block_list.name: Passionate Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Isn't that racing outfit something crafted 
with all your hopes and wishes in it?!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: ...That is...

text_block_list.name: Passionate Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Don't give up here! Tell me what your wish 
is!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
...! I won't lose... I just don't want to 
lose to anyone! That's all!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: A wish poured into your racewear...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
...I asked for my racing racewear to be 
designed in a way that would make me feel 
fulfilled.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
You told me that I was kind, Trainer, but 
that is not the case.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"Because if someone gets hurt right in 
front of you, it breaks your heart and 
makes you sad, doesn't it?"

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I just really hate feeling that way... In 
short, it's completely for my own 
satisfaction.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
There is no need to feel grateful, nor is 
there any need to feel apologetic.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry about me, just accepting me as 
I am is all you need to do~

This Racewear was clearly made with 
someone special in mind.

This Racewear was clearly made with 
someone special in mind.
It hurts because you're so kind.
It hurts because you're so kind, you know.

Don't worry about me, just accepting me as

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Well...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, even if I call it self-satisfaction, 
that's how you interpret it, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: The one who is truly kind is you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Someone so kind... Ehehe, I can't help but 
want to spoil you♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: But... yes.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"...Even in the harsh world of racing, if 
only I could bring healing to someone."

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
That is the wish I poured into my 
racewear.

With a slightly firmer gaze than usual, 
Super Creek muttered as if resolving 
herself to something.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
...What should I do? If you say something 
so adorable, I... I...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
It makes me want to pamper you right this 
second, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Since we have the chance, how about a lap 
pillow?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"This racing outfit feels so soft against 
the skin, it's super comfy~."

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"Come now, don't be shy. Let's go lounge 
over on that bench."

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
...I want to soothe hard-working, kind 
people as much as I possibly can♪

I stopped an excited Super Creek and 
managed to decline the lap pillow...
